C3.reason: Fixture bug in the v0.12.0 runner: the C3 probe inserts a user_identities row with user_id=1 without creating a user, so the qiick/laravel-oidc foreign key rejects it on PostgreSQL and MySQL before the case-sensitivity assertion runs. Tracked in #380; upstream fix pending.

C17.reason: Tracked security work, not hidden: erasure releases unique email/username, anonymises personal columns, deletes SSO identities, passkeys and assistant chats, and deactivates the row. Only anonymising identifying payload in existing activity rows remains (#381); the hook scans both activity columns on the app's own created/updated rows so a stale divergence is caught.

C20.reason: One backed error-code enum with a stable JSON error shape for /api/* and /mcp is not implemented yet. Product tests already pin the safe behaviours (no stack trace with APP_DEBUG=false, JSON without Accept); tracked in #390, not hidden.

C21.reason: Accept-Language negotiation does not set Content-Language on responses yet. Tracked in #386, not hidden.

C24.reason: X-Request-Id response header and log propagation are not implemented yet. Tracked in #388, not hidden.

C25.reason: HTTP-level Idempotency-Key replay on retryable creates is not implemented yet: ingest already de-duplicates by batchId (201 for a new batch, 200 for a repeat), but that is payload identity, not a replayed request with the same key and body. Tracked in #383, not hidden.

C26.reason: No OpenAPI 3.1 document covering the named /api routes (reports, runtime, exceptions) exists yet. Tracked in #378, not hidden.

C27.reason: Outbound webhooks do not use Standard Webhooks headers and the {type,timestamp,data} envelope yet. Tracked in #389, not hidden.

C29.reason: Excubia has no organisations or Spatie teams today, so team switching is out of scope. It will add principals.organisation_id as NOT NULL together with Spatie teams when organisations arrive. Tracked in #387, not hidden.
